items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury; optimistic reports Saturday after feeling better.
items.why: Calf minor per McVay; no setbacks, feeling better Saturday.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; high target share expected without Adams.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets as primary option; reverse any backup beneficiaries.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially INACTIVE for Week 7 vs Dolphins; unlikely after limited practice, misses fourth straight with quad.
items.why: Not full participant yet; early in recovery from quad strain.
items.implication: Sit Hall; Braelon Allen locked as workhorse RB1 vs soft Miami run D.
items.opportunity: Allen full snaps/carries/routes; high volume beneficiary.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; will miss third straight game. Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: Downgraded Saturday; limited practice all week but not ready.
items.implication: Ravens QB downgrade; Huntley streaming option in 2QB/superflex.
items.opportunity: Increased rushing upside for Huntley; possible Zay Flowers/Mark Andrews volume shift.

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) both ruled OUT for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.why: Full DNPs; Smith hamstring, Wicks ankle.
items.implication: PHI pass game thinned; elevated roles for remaining WRs/TE with Hurts or backup.
items.opportunity: Target share spike for other PHI pass-catchers; Goedert/others.

items.text: Thinks Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain; after big 17/124/1 game where he felt something late.
items.why: Felt something on final carry; post-game comments.
items.implication: Bye week to heal; monitor for Week 8; big production if healthy.
items.opportunity: Confirmed lead role with volume; Tracy also hamstring.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs turned ankle on purposeful slide but almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide; no major concern post-game.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY MNF vs Cowboys after returning to practice from hamstring; questionable but in line.
items.why: Back at practice; efficient when healthy; good matchup.
items.implication: Start if confirmed active; RB1 upside vs DAL.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN and active for Week 7; cleared after layoff.
items.implication: Startable but workload questions post-layoff per some.
items.opportunity: Lead back role if full go.

items.text: Panthers RT Taylor Moton suffered fractured fibula, out indefinitely after returning from blood clot.
items.implication: OL hit for CAR; potential impact on run game/QB protection for fantasy RBs/QB.

items.text: Texans activated WR Tank Dell to active roster; set for first action in nearly two years.
items.implication: Deep league stash/watch; potential role in HOU WR corps.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI for usage/matchup; back in real role, Bears good for yardage.
items.why: Usage rebound + favorable Bears matchup for pass catchers.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET; Lions TE buffet defense (9 TE TDs allowed), Kraft TE6.
items.why: Elite TE matchup vs Lions who gift points to TEs.

items.text: Loves volume RBs Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for big workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Consistent volume + defenses carved by RBs.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (Gonzalez shadow, outside routes) and Josh Downs @ MIN (target share/low-scoring issues).
items.conflict: Usage may still be there but suppressed by D.
